korean_language_program.name: Sejong Language Center (세종어학원, formerly Center for International Education)
korean_language_program.evidence: Sejong Language Center is a Korean language institute established to inherit and develop the spirit of King Sejong’s creation of Hangul.

english_taught_degrees.detail: Undergraduate English Track: Public Administration, Media and Communication, Business Administration, Economics, Hospitality and Tourism Management, Computer Science and Engineering, Comics & Animation Technology, School of Global Liberal Studies, School of Humanities and Social Sciences, AI and Software, Smart Mobility, K-Pop Entertainment, Visual and Performing Content, Contemporary Music (freshman list); graduate guide also has an English-track applicant route
english_taught_degrees.evidence: ※English Track programs provide entire courses in English.

support_services.evidence: Global Buddy is a volunteering group among the university’s Korean students that help the international students at Sejong University to build real friendships
Click the link below and write your name, university, number of persons, number of luggage, flight information, arrival date and time, departure city, country, specific address of destination.
A program led by Sejong University undergraduate students, who serve as mentors, offering international students opportunities to experience Korean language and culture.

dormitory.note: Rates for 6 months as of Fall 2025; Happy/Saimdang/off-campus/Gwanggaeto; 2–4 bed rooms; page notes new students have priority. Admission guide states ~1.6M KRW per 6 months and ~255 places (see conflicts).
